title: How rural life becomes a modern fantasy
titleChinese: 现代人为何憧憬乡村生活？
paragraphs: Rolling hills and endless green pastures – those images are easy to conjure when thinking of the idyllic country lifestyle. When lockdowns descended upon many countries across the world during the pandemic, social media seemed to be dominated by pictures of cottages and village life – people getting away from it all. So, why is living in the countryside becoming a modern fantasy – and are there benefits to considering a slower pace of life?

It makes sense that some people would want to give up the crowded and noisy city streets for the perceived tranquillity of the traditional country life – especially during an event like a pandemic. The lockdowns and extensive periods of working from home have given people time to think about what they want from life. But it’s not just about having a greener place to look at out your window.

There is more evidence that relates to the benefits of rural living. Villages aren’t normally subject to the stop-go traffic we see in city centres, the buses fighting with taxis for dominance, or metro systems with trains that scream from one station to the next. In short, there’s less air pollution in your country retreat – a thing which increases the chances of developing respiratory conditions or heart disease. You also get more opportunities to take long walks and see the sights, meaning you can get more exercise. Less noise, more walks and better air can also lead to less stress and an increased life expectancy, according to studies such as one conducted by the British government in 2012.

However, there are some things that need to be considered. Living far from the hustle and bustle of the city means that some people may feel isolated or even lonely. And as people get older, life far from doctors or public transport could become a bit of a challenge. So, if you’re considering a change of pace and moving to a picturesque village, there is a range of pros and cons to consider before taking the plunge.

vocabulary.entry: conjure /ˈkʌndʒə(r)/ v. 使……浮现于脑海；想象
vocabulary.example: The smell of sea salt conjures up memories of our holiday.
vocabulary.translation: 海盐的气息让我们想起了度假的时光。

vocabulary.entry: idyllic /ɪˈdɪlɪk/ adj. 田园诗般的；宁静美好的
vocabulary.example: They live an idyllic life in a cottage in the mountains.
vocabulary.translation: 他们在山间小屋过着田园诗般的生活。

vocabulary.entry: descend /dɪˈsend/ v. 降临；来临
vocabulary.example: Silence descended on the crowd as the performer walked on stage.
vocabulary.translation: 表演者走上舞台时，人群安静了下来。

vocabulary.entry: dominate /ˈdɒmɪneɪt/ v. 占据主导地位；充斥
vocabulary.example: Sports news dominates the headlines on the back page.
vocabulary.translation: 体育新闻占据了报纸封底的头条。

vocabulary.entry: cottage /ˈkɒtɪdʒ/ n. （乡村的）小屋；村舍
vocabulary.example: We rented a little cottage by the lake for the summer.
vocabulary.translation: 我们夏天租了湖边的一间小农舍。

vocabulary.term: get away from it all 逃离一切喧嚣；抽身静养
vocabulary.entry: get away from it all 逃离一切喧嚣；抽身静养
vocabulary.example: We go hiking every year to get away from it all.
vocabulary.translation: 我们每年都会去徒步旅行，逃离一切喧嚣。

vocabulary.entry: fantasy /ˈfæntəsi/ n. 幻想；憧憬
vocabulary.example: For her, a holiday in the Caribbean was a childhood fantasy.
vocabulary.translation: 对她来说，去加勒比度假是儿时的憧憬。

vocabulary.entry: tranquillity /træŋˈkwɪləti/ n. 宁静；平静
vocabulary.example: The hotel is a haven of tranquillity away from the city noise.
vocabulary.translation: 这家酒店是远离城市喧嚣的宁静港湾。

vocabulary.entry: extensive /ɪkˈstensɪv/ adj. 漫长的；广泛的
vocabulary.example: She has extensive experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
vocabulary.translation: 她在英语作为外语教学方面有着丰富的经验。

vocabulary.entry: rural /ˈrʊərəl/ adj. 乡村的；农村的
vocabulary.example: The government is promoting rural development projects.
vocabulary.translation: 政府正在推进农村发展项目。

vocabulary.entry: stop-go traffic /ˌstɒp ɡəʊ ˈtræfɪk/ n. 走走停停的车流
vocabulary.example: We were stuck in stop-go traffic for an hour on the way to the airport.
vocabulary.translation: 去机场的路上，我们在走走停停的车流里堵了一个小时。

vocabulary.entry: dominance /ˈdɒmɪnəns/ n. 主导地位；支配地位
vocabulary.example: The company fought hard to maintain its dominance in the market.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司努力争取维持其在市场中的主导地位。

vocabulary.entry: scream /skriːm/ v. 呼啸着移动
vocabulary.example: The train screamed through the tunnel at high speed.
vocabulary.translation: 火车高速呼啸着穿过隧道。

vocabulary.entry: retreat /rɪˈtriːt/ n. 僻静的居所；休养处
vocabulary.example: The cabin in the woods is our favourite weekend retreat.
vocabulary.translation: 林间小屋是我们最喜欢的周末休憩之所。

vocabulary.entry: respiratory /rəˈspɪrətri/ adj. 呼吸的；与呼吸有关的
vocabulary.example: The patient was admitted to hospital with a respiratory infection.
vocabulary.translation: 这位患者因呼吸道感染入院治疗。

vocabulary.entry: life expectancy /ˌlaɪf ɪkˈspektənsi/ n. 预期寿命
vocabulary.example: Improved healthcare has led to an increase in life expectancy.
vocabulary.translation: 医疗保健水平的提高使得预期寿命有所延长。

vocabulary.entry: hustle and bustle /ˌhʌsl ən ˈbʌsl/ n. 喧嚣；熙熙攘攘
vocabulary.example: She loves the hustle and bustle of the city at the weekend.
vocabulary.translation: 她喜欢周末城市里的熙熙攘攘。

vocabulary.entry: isolated /ˈaɪsəleɪtɪd/ adj. 孤独的；与世隔绝的
vocabulary.example: The small village is isolated by mountains on all sides.
vocabulary.translation: 这个小村庄四面环山，与世隔绝。

vocabulary.entry: public transport /ˌpʌblɪk ˈtrænspɔːt/ n. 公共交通
vocabulary.example: Public transport is very convenient in this part of the city.
vocabulary.translation: 城市的这个区域公共交通十分便利。

vocabulary.entry: picturesque /ˌpɪktʃəˈresk/ adj. 风景如画的
vocabulary.example: We drove along a picturesque road through the countryside.
vocabulary.translation: 我们沿着一条风景如画的乡间小路驱车前行。

vocabulary.entry: pros and cons /ˌprəʊz ən ˈkɒnz/ n. 利弊；优缺点
vocabulary.example: We need to weigh up the pros and cons before making a decision.
vocabulary.translation: 做决定之前，我们需要权衡利弊。

vocabulary.entry: take the plunge /teɪk ðə plʌndʒ/ （经过犹豫后）果断行动；冒险一试
vocabulary.example: After months of thinking, she finally took the plunge and started her own business.
vocabulary.translation: 经过数月的考虑，她终于下定决心，创业了。

vocabulary.entry: perceived /pəˈsiːvd/ adj. 被认为的；被感知的
vocabulary.example: The perceived risk of the project was much higher than the actual risk.
vocabulary.translation: 这个项目被感知到的风险远高于实际风险。

vocabulary.entry: condition /kənˈdɪʃn/ n. 疾病
vocabulary.example: He suffers from a chronic heart condition.
vocabulary.translation: 他患有慢性心脏病。

vocabulary.entry: pace /peɪs/ n. 节奏；步调
vocabulary.example: She prefers the slower pace of life in the countryside.
vocabulary.translation: 她更喜欢乡村里更慢的生活节奏。

sentences.english: Rolling hills and endless green pastures – those images are easy to conjure when thinking of the idyllic country lifestyle.
sentences.chinese: 连绵起伏的山丘、一望无际的青青牧场——一想到田园诗般的乡村生活，这些画面便会油然而生。

sentences.english: When lockdowns descended upon many countries across the world during the pandemic, social media seemed to be dominated by pictures of cottages and village life – people getting away from it all.
sentences.chinese: 疫情期间，当世界上许多国家开始实施封锁政策时，社交媒体上便被乡村小屋和田园生活的照片刷屏——人们都想逃离喧嚣，寻一处宁静之地。

sentences.english: So, why is living in the countryside becoming a modern fantasy – and are there benefits to considering a slower pace of life?
sentences.chinese: 那么，为什么居住在乡村会成为一种现代憧憬？选择放慢生活节奏又是否真的有益呢？

sentences.english: It makes sense that some people would want to give up the crowded and noisy city streets for the perceived tranquillity of the traditional country life – especially during an event like a pandemic.
sentences.chinese: 不难理解，有些人愿意告别拥挤嘈杂的城市街道，去追寻传统乡村生活中那份印象中的宁静，尤其是在疫情这样的特殊时期。

sentences.english: The lockdowns and extensive periods of working from home have given people time to think about what they want from life.
sentences.chinese: 封锁政策和长时间的居家办公，让人们得以静下心来思考自己真正想要的生活。

sentences.english: But it’s not just about having a greener place to look at out your window.
sentences.chinese: 但这种向往，绝不仅仅是为了能在窗边看到一片更绿意盎然的景色。

sentences.english: There is more evidence that relates to the benefits of rural living.
sentences.chinese: 有更多证据表明乡村生活益处良多。

sentences.english: Villages aren’t normally subject to the stop-go traffic we see in city centres, the buses fighting with taxis for dominance, or metro systems with trains that scream from one station to the next.
sentences.chinese: 乡村通常不会出现市中心那种走走停停的拥堵车流，不会有公交车和出租车抢道争行的混乱场面，也不会有地铁列车呼啸着穿梭于各个站点的嘈杂。

sentences.english: In short, there’s less air pollution in your country retreat – a thing which increases the chances of developing respiratory conditions or heart disease.
sentences.chinese: 简而言之，你的乡村居所空气污染更少——而空气污染恰恰会增加人们患上呼吸系统疾病或心脏病的风险。

sentences.english: You also get more opportunities to take long walks and see the sights, meaning you can get more exercise.
sentences.chinese: 你还能有更多机会漫步赏景，这意味着可以获得更多的运动量。

sentences.english: Less noise, more walks and better air can also lead to less stress and an increased life expectancy, according to studies such as one conducted by the British government in 2012.
sentences.chinese: 英国政府2012年开展的一项研究等相关调查显示，更少的噪音、更多的散步机会以及更优质的空气，还能有效减轻压力，延长人的预期寿命。

sentences.english: However, there are some things that need to be considered.
sentences.chinese: 不过，也有一些问题需要考虑。

sentences.english: Living far from the hustle and bustle of the city means that some people may feel isolated or even lonely.
sentences.chinese: 远离城市的喧嚣意味着有些人可能会感到与世隔绝，甚至产生孤独感。

sentences.english: And as people get older, life far from doctors or public transport could become a bit of a challenge.
sentences.chinese: 而且随着人们年龄增长，居住在远离医生和公共交通的地方，生活可能会变得有些艰难。

sentences.english: So, if you’re considering a change of pace and moving to a picturesque village, there is a range of pros and cons to consider before taking the plunge.
sentences.chinese: 所以，如果你正考虑改变生活节奏，搬到风景如画的乡村居住，那么在仓促决定之前，一定要权衡好其中的利弊。
